[h3]1. Pneuma cap increased to 9999.[/h3]
Note: When dismantling ectoplasm decay, dismantling will be unavailable if the cap is exceeded.

[h3]2. New combat state detection.[/h3]
Note:
[list]
[*] When within enemy sight range and landing a valid hit, you will enter the [b]"In Combat"[/b] state.
[*] While in combat, devices such as the World Book cannot be used for 5 seconds.
[/list]

The game now supports Simplified Chinese and Japanese.

[h3]1. Sun-series magic trigger adjustment.[/h3]
Note: When Original Sin attacks land a valid hit, they now trigger Sun-series magic [b]without consuming the hit count[/b] of the Original Sin attack.
(This ensures energy spheres for Sun magic can always be struck and detonated, even when overlapping with enemies.)

[h2][b]Balance:[/b][/h2]

[h3]1. Affix: Blood Tears.[/h3]
Note: Stamina reduction no longer scales with [b]Intelligence (Int)[/b].

[h3]2. Another World Skill: Hell Paradise.[/h3]
Note: Casting time has been shortened.

notes.title: Update Version 1.88

[h2][b]New Update:[/b][/h2]

[h3]1. New Ukehi Added: “The Ukehi of Behemoth.”[/h3]

Description:

The blessing of the abyssal beast has been transformed into an unbreakable Oath.  
While under its effect, your max HP will increase, and each time you cast a Ukehi skill, a small portion of your health will be restored.

[h3]2. New Characters Introduced: Retrievers Ron and Saif.[/h3]

Description:

Two unusual visitors have arrived at the East Side Port.  
They call themselves “Retrievers,” specialists in corpse recovery and relic retrieval within the ruins.  
With the aid of a unique arcane device, they can **locate the remains of the fallen**—provided the deceased still carries their **Adventurer’s Writ**.  
Approach them, and you may hear forgotten stories and unseen memories from the depths of the ruins.

[h3]3. Enchanted Artifact Adjustments[/h3]

Description:

To better align with the world of *Hope Trigger*, we’ve redesigned the visuals and tier classifications of “Enchanted Artifacts.”

[h3]4. Item and Material Adjustments[/h3]

Description:

The visuals and descriptions of various items and materials have been redesigned to better fit the setting of *Hope Trigger*.

[h3]5. Updated Icons for AnotherWorld Skills and Class Buffs[/h3]

Description:

We have redrawn the buff icons for AnotherWorld Skills and class-related effects to improve readability and to reflect the unique symbolism and style of each class.

[h3]6. Magic and Status Resistance Icon Overhaul[/h3]

Description:

All icons related to magic resistance and abnormal status resistance have been completely redrawn to enhance clarity and visual consistency.

[h3]7. Quest Interface Icon Update[/h3]

Description:

To better match the overall art direction of *Hope Trigger*, we have replaced the icons associated with the quest interface.
